cards.owner: Sonnet worker; coordinator ran the tests and added one fix
cards.scope: Fix the re-check's residual findings N1 to N4.
cards.evidenceText: Historical local evidence, superseded for readiness by the M14-F3-HOLD finding, which is now fixed and accepted locally by Codex. N1 to N4 were fixed: reads at confirmed commitment with a fail-closed check, durable and fail-closed write-ahead and receipt files, and the packet pin recorded in write-ahead records. The once-only funding guard it added counts only confirmed records. Codex found that a missing or failed lookup after blockhash expiry could still bypass it. Tool tests 30/30 and runner tests 12/12 passed; the full plan passed; the real-node lifecycle ran in 24 s, down from 120 s. Coordinator-verified.

cards.owner: Sonnet worker; coordinator runs the tests
cards.scope: Narrow fix: never treat a missing or failed signature lookup after blockhash expiry as proof that a transaction never landed.
cards.evidenceText: Codex source review found that, after a blockhash expired, a missing recent-cache status or a lookup error was recorded as never landed, so a landed funding transfer could have been sent twice. Fixed: lookups search transaction history, such records stay held as unknown and block execution, and only a later positive history result clears them, with a confirmed result restoring the once-only guard. The tool has no command to clear an unknown record. Codex's bounded independent closure review: PASS, local source and test boundary only. It found no blocking issue, read the zero-additional-send regressions and matched the test-summary hash. Codex did not re-run the tests; the coordinator's local runs are the test evidence. No approval implied.

cards.scope: Rob's approval of Block A: the Solana-devnet-only acceptance run.
cards.evidenceText: Rob wrote "approved". The message just before it was a board-metadata update, and the specific Block A question had been asked earlier, so the supervisor asked Rob to confirm that it means Block A. Until Rob confirms, nothing is sent to a public network, including faucet requests, and silence is not approval. Only the local rebuild under a fresh program id continues. If confirmed, Block A means: fresh devnet test keys, faucet-only devnet SOL within a coordinator-kept budget, deploy and governance setup, then the committed flow plan over about 41.5 days. Every ICP action, real PP minting, any unknown-transaction retry, mainnet and the PR merge stay held.
